title.narrative: Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project (Project Design Advance)

description.narrative: The Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project will support investments to revive the fisheries sector in the conflict affected coastal districts of Jaffna, Mannar, Mullaitivu, and Killinochchi. Investments are required to (i) rebuild large scale infrastructure, such as harbors, anchorages, and associated facilities, (ii) introduce new fishery technologies, (iii) expand aquaculture sustainably (iv) strengthen community based organizations and related institutions, and (v) develop economic activities for households headed by women, war widows and single women. The is aligned with the following impacts: (i) investments in the fishery subsector promoted, and (ii) employment and livelihood opportunities in the Northern Province promoted. The outcome will be fishery production and livelihood opportunities in four coastal districts of the Northern Province increased. The proposed outputs will be: (i) Marine fisheries infrastructure constructed; (ii) Aquaculture developed; and (iii) entrepreneurial skills, market links and credit access for local communities; and capacities of government staff strengthened;. The Project Design Advance supports the preparation of detailed designs and procurement for output 1.

description.narrative: Fisheries production in the Northern Province sustainably increased
4% increase of women participation in fisheries related industries (2016 baseline: 11%) Progress/Status: Not yet due Data Source: Project baseline and end line survey Actual value:

Aquaculture production increased to approximately 500mt per year (wet weight) (2016 baseline: total approximately 275mt wet weight, with sea cucumber: 60 to 65mt; Mud crab 10 to 12mt; Seaweed 200mt) Progress/Status: Not yet due Data Source: Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Annual Reports Actual value:
Marine fish production increased to 85,000MT per year (from 2015 baseline 72,560MT) Progress/Status: Not yet due Data Source: Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Annual Reports Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Climate-resilient infrastructure developed and operational Indicator: 2 new harbors constructed and operational at Pt. Pedro and Pesalai, with total basin area of 21 ha Progress/Status: Detailed designs are completed for both harbors. Data Source: Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development Annual Reports Actual value:

Output: Aquaculture developed Indicator: 1 aquaculture training center established and operational (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Under the PDA there were no activities for this output Data Source: National Aquaculture Development Authority Annual reports Actual value:

Output: Aquaculture developed Indicator: 1 mud crab hatchery established and operational, producing 1.0mn crablets per year (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Under the PDA there were no activities for this output Data Source: National Aquaculture Development Authority Annual reports Actual value:

Output: Aquaculture developed Indicator: 1 sea cucumber hatchery established and operational, producing 1.5mn juveniles per year (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Under the PDA there were no activities for this output Data Source: National Aquaculture Development Authority Annual reports Actual value:

Output: Aquaculture developed Indicator: 1 seaweed tissue culture laboratory established and operational, producing 30,000 to 50,000kg of propagules (germlings) per year (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Under the PDA there were no activities for this output Data Source: National Aquaculture Development Authority Annual reports Actual value:

Output: Climate-resilient infrastructure developed and operational Indicator: 8 anchorages and 25 landing sites rehabilitated Progress/Status: detailed designs for one anchorage and 23 landing sites have been completed. others were dropped due to scarcity of the land area for development. Data Source: Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development Annual Reports Actual value:
